author: copilot
subject: Implemented and validated the live-v5 performance contract
body: Implemented the approved schema-v5 contract as 42 cases over five persistent deterministic fixtures. The runner now measures flat, delimiter, paginated and account listings plus complete staged-block sequences and committed block-list reads; Gateway telemetry records exact entries scanned; listing gates use requests per scanned entry while new exact costs are established fail-closed from stable repeats. Repeated schema-v4/v5 telemetry is aggregated server-side in Log Analytics to avoid raw-event recovery stalls. Fixture containers and symmetric caller/reconciler RBAC are provisioned on all three replicas. Schemas v1-v4 remain supported.
